headline: CFTC clears perps on U.S. stocks

scenes.vo: Crypto's favorite trading product just got cleared for American stocks. Here's what changed.
The CFTC says perpetual futures on individual stocks can trade on U.S. exchanges for the first time. Its chairman says they count as security futures, so the SEC oversees them too.
Here's why traders are watching it. Perpetual futures never expire, and they drive most crypto trading. Now that model is moving onto regulated Wall Street exchanges.
The catch. No exchange, stock or launch date was named. And these contracts usually come with leverage, which can wipe out traders fast.
Here's what happens next. Watch which exchanges file to list these first, and whether big crypto exchanges get involved.
